lines.2: 「Inori overslept and will be late. I flew on ahead by myself.」
lines.5: 「Now, now, settle down, chicks. I dislike creatures who chirp and squawk like a flock of birds.」
lines.6: 「Allow me to impart some valuable knowledge. You see, peaches are an expensive dessert--」
lines.7: What century is that bird from...?
